summary_en: This Phase I/II study tests intraperitoneal paclitaxel, a chemotherapy drug given directly into the abdominal cavity, in people with metastatic appendiceal adenocarcinoma. The intervention list also names dexamethasone, diphenhydramine and famotidine, each listed as given by mouth, and how often or how long any drug is given is not stated. The study aims to find the recommended paclitaxel dose, and the outcome measure is stated only as finding that dose; the study is Phase I/II.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase I/II evalúa paclitaxel intraperitoneal, un medicamento de quimioterapia que se administra directamente en la cavidad abdominal, en personas con adenocarcinoma apendicular metastásico. La lista de intervenciones también incluye dexametasona, difenhidramina y famotidina, que aparecen como administrados por vía oral; la frecuencia o la duración de cualquier medicamento no se indica. El estudio busca encontrar la dosis recomendada de paclitaxel, y la medida de resultado solo se indica como encontrar esa dosis; el estudio es de fase I/II.
who_for: Histologically confirmed unresectable metastatic appendiceal adenocarcinoma, with disease in the peritoneal cavity.
Not a candidate for cytoreductive surgery.
Adequate blood cell counts, liver and kidney function.
not_for: Active infection that would preclude protocol therapy.
Unstable angina or New York Heart Association grade II or greater heart failure.
Unable to comply with study procedures, such as due to cognitive impairment.
